title: Release of the MJ-12 documents
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Release of the MJ-12 documents, about 1984-1990s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So the MJ12 documents came out from 84. It was a string of documents ' 84 into the '90s.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the MJ-12 documents, papers describing a secret group of officials said to handle UFO matters, began coming out in 1984 and kept appearing as a string of documents into the 1990s. He mentions a scientist named Detlev Bronk in connection with them, and the papers matter because, if real, they would show a high-level secret group managing the UFO question.
